unresolved.why: Neither is annotated at the nozzle or on the short run leaving it. The run reaches 3"-PL-25-007001-N2A1-ET only after the FIF-0701 / analyzer section and a spec change.

AM sits on the bolted top cover and AO on the pipe run leaving it. AO is taken as the nozzle mark because on the companion sheets AM/BM/DM mark manways and covers while letter pairs like AO mark process nozzles. Placement alone does not settle it.

The 3"-PL-25-006002-TFE2-ET label sits downstream of the mixer. It is assigned to both mixer ports because the mixer and its bypass sit on one continuous run, but the label is not adjacent to the inlet flange.
No PDF text layer was supplied, so every tag, size and line number was read visually from the raster and cross-checked between the equipment data block and the in-drawing labels.
